transformation: Use arm-specific trial probabilities; PSA samples control risk and published RR.
uncertainty_strategy: Published trial uncertainty plus subgroup scenario.
residual_risk: Household clustering and future variant immunity may change absolute risk.

source_population: Japanese high-risk diagnosed outpatients, Nov 2022 to Jul 2023
target_population: Symptomatic breakthrough COVID-19 after household PEP
transformation: Apply untreated 28-day all-cause hospitalization risk, then multiply by hospitalization_attribution_fraction before assigning COVID-19 costs and mortality.
direction_of_bias: Likely conservative for older frail contacts; possibly high if incidental admissions included.
residual_risk: All-cause outcome, employer-based claims, limited older adults, no vaccination data, and uncertain causal attribution.

target_population: Future breakthrough hospitalizations in both arms
transformation: Apply observed in-hospital mortality conditional on admission.
direction_of_bias: Could overestimate mortality if future cases are milder.
residual_risk: Case mix, admission threshold, and treatment evolve over time.

target_quantity: Lifetime QALYs lost per acute death
source_population: Japanese late-Omicron hospitalized cohort age-sex proxy, national life table, population utilities
target_population: Deaths prevented in high-risk household contacts
transformation: Integrate age-sex survival and EQ-5D-5L utility from an age-82, 54%-male proxy cohort at 2% annual discount.
uncertainty_strategy: Age 85 and age 75 sensitivity values 5.320961 and 9.778527.
direction_of_bias: Age 82 may understate loss for younger deaths and overstate loss for older deaths.
residual_risk: Decedent age distribution unavailable; admission sex share used; 90+ utility carried forward; survival truncated at 105.

target_quantity: Direct payer cost per COVID-19 hospitalization
transformation: Use all-case median cost; severe median defines upper range.
uncertainty_strategy: PERT 798810 to 6210607 plus cost factor 0.8 to 1.2.
direction_of_bias: Base may understate current severe or long-stay cases.
residual_risk: Median versus mean, pre-Omicron period, single center, and price-year mismatch.

target_quantity: Attributable QALY loss from months 1 to 12
source_population: 302 COVID-19 cases and 77 test-negative controls in a single-clinic retrospective recall survey; median age 42 years
target_population: Surviving symptomatic breakthrough cases in high-risk contacts
transformation: Integrate recalled control-minus-COVID EQ-5D-5L differences from months 1-3, 3-6, and 6-12; apply to each surviving symptomatic case.
uncertainty_strategy: PERT range plus scenarios excluding months 6-12, halving the total profile, and excluding all post-acute loss.
direction_of_bias: Likely favors PEP if recall/selection bias or near-ceiling control values inflate the difference; may understate burden in older or immunocompromised cases.
residual_risk: No prospective pre-infection baseline, small control group, and limited transportability to high-risk household contacts.

residual_risk: Actual billing combinations and pharmacy categories vary.
